ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high contrast with a high-intensity white central area comprising approximately 75% of the visible surface against low-intensity black borders and notch intrusion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white blobs on the left and right lobes; a low-intensity black wedge-shaped region intrudes from the median notch toward the center; dense black banding persists along the distal and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with visible edges converging at approximately 55 degrees; the vertex point is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entirety of the visible trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits more pronounced, jagged peaks (5-10 pixel amplitude) near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convex curves; the right lobe shows a sharper, more elongated distal sweep compared to the more rounded left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, dark circular pixel groups visible on the far right distal tip and a sparse scattering of dark dots across the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, near-vertical low-intensity linear mark extending approximately 1/3 the height of the right lobe; smaller, parallel vertical streaks are visible on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced vertical rake mark on the right lobe; irregular jagged loss of material on the far right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark pigmented 'island' or focal spot located near the inner boundary of the left lobe's white field.
